page.title: OurTaikoPlay · Every beat, together
page.description: OurTaikoPlay is an open-source taiko rhythm game with a Nijiiro-style interface, keyboard, mouse and touch controls, local TJA charts and an online library. Download for Windows, macOS and Android, or join the iOS TestFlight.
hero.description: An open-source taiko rhythm game with a familiar Nijiiro feel. Play with a keyboard or touch, browse the online library or bring your own TJA charts.
features.title: Familiar rhythms. More to enjoy.
features.sub: From your first Don to your next full combo.
feature.flowText: Entry, song select, play and results. Drumrolls, balloons, kusudama, BPM and scroll changes, and normal, expert and master branches.
feature.modesText: Solo, two players on one screen, ghost battles, dan courses, and online rooms where up to five play the same song.
feature.skinText: Song panels, difficulty cards, nameplates, the soul gauge, dancers and results bring that familiar taiko feel to your device.
feature.inputText: Use the keyboard on a computer and on-screen drums on mobile. Big notes count with a hit on either side.
feature.library: Local charts and an online library
feature.libraryText: Reads local TJA charts and box.def folders. The built-in OurTaiko library downloads songs, keeps them offline and syncs your scores.
feature.charaText: Moves and changes expression with the rhythm and how you play. Change outfits and pick companions in Settings.
feature.audioText: Mixing and decoding with BASS, with WASAPI and ASIO output to choose from.
feature.roomsText: Open a room and play the same song online with friends — up to five players.
feature.languagesText: The whole interface in Simplified Chinese, English and Japanese.
controls.title: Don! Ka! That’s all it takes.
controls.sub: Default keyboard controls · On-screen drums on mobile
download.title: Ready? Let’s play!
download.sub: Windows, macOS and Android have stable releases and Nightly builds. On iOS, join the TestFlight beta.
download.macSpec: Universal for Intel and Apple silicon · ZIP
download.androidRun: Download and install on your device
download.rhythmhubText: On Windows and macOS, the RhythmHub launcher installs OurTaikoPlay, lets you choose stable or daily builds, and updates it in the background.
download.allText: Every version’s packages and notes are on GitHub Releases. Linux x64 is available in Nightly builds only for now.
download.note: The download buttons open the GitHub release page; pick the package for your device under Assets. Nightly builds are in development and may have unfixed issues.
guide.title: Three steps. Your stage.
guide.sub: First time here? Start right here.
guide.installText: Choose your platform above. Extract and run on Windows, install the APK on Android, or install TestFlight first on iPhone and iPad.
guide.songsText: Sign in or connect to the online library as a guest. You can also place local TJA charts and their audio in the game’s Songs folder.
guide.playText: Choose a song and difficulty, then play with your keyboard or on-screen drums. Want another try? Pause or restart anytime.
